title: Stationary point from a shifted quadratic
statement:
Find the absolute minimum value of $(x-[$a])^2-4$ on $[0,10]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Report the output, rather than that input.
solution: The square becomes zero at $x=[$a]$, an allowed input, giving the minimum $-4$.
